essays.title: 通知国际学生参加歌唱比赛
essays.sourceNote: 英文正文与格式来自用户本轮提供的确认材料，原文保持不变。

paragraphs.text: A Singing Contest will be held in the university auditorium at 7:00 p.m. on September 20.

paragraphs.text: Each participant may perform one Chinese or English song within five minutes.

paragraphs.text: Those who wish to take part should register at the Students’ Union office before September 15.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 希望参加的人应在9月15日前到学生会办公室报名。

paragraphs.text: Please provide your name, student number and song title.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 请提供姓名、学号和歌曲名称。

paragraphs.text: We sincerely look forward to your participation.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我们真诚期待你的参与。

essays.title: 给准备在中国找工作的外国朋友提建议

paragraphs.text: I am glad to hear that you have graduated from college and plan to find a job in China.

paragraphs.text: You may also use reliable recruitment websites and attend job fairs.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 你还可以使用可靠的招聘网站并参加招聘会。

paragraphs.text: I hope these suggestions will be useful.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我希望这些建议会有用。

paragraphs.text: I wish you success in finding an ideal job.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 祝你成功找到理想的工作。

essays.title: 回复如何准备中国古代科学家口头报告
essays.sourceNote: 英文正文与格式来自用户本轮提供的确认材料，原文保持不变。

paragraphs.text: I am glad to offer you some advice on preparing your oral report about an ancient Chinese scientist.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我很高兴就准备中国古代科学家口头报告给你一些建议。

paragraphs.text: First, choose a scientist whose achievements are both important and easy to explain, such as Zhang Heng or Zu Chongzhi.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 首先，选择一位成就重要且容易解释的科学家，例如张衡或祖冲之。

paragraphs.text: Then collect reliable information about his life, major discoveries and influence on later generations.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 然后收集关于他的生平、主要发现及其对后世影响的可靠信息。

paragraphs.text: It is better to organize your report into three parts: a brief introduction, his main contribution and your personal comments.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 最好把报告分成三部分：简要介绍、主要贡献和个人评论。

paragraphs.text: You may also use pictures or a simple timeline to make the report clearer.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 你还可以使用图片或简单时间线，使报告更清晰。

paragraphs.text: Finally, practise several times and control your speaking time.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 最后，多练习几次并控制发言时间。

paragraphs.text: I hope these suggestions will help you complete an impressive report.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我希望这些建议能帮助你完成一份令人印象深刻的报告。

essays.title: 就塑料袋和白色污染问题给报社编辑写信
essays.sourceNote: 英文正文与格式来自用户本轮提供的确认材料，原文保持不变。

paragraphs.text: I am writing to express my concern about the continued use of plastic bags in our city.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我写信是为了表达对本市继续使用塑料袋的担忧。

paragraphs.text: Although restrictions have been introduced, many shops still provide them freely, and “white pollution” remains a serious problem.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 尽管已经出台限制措施，许多商店仍免费提供塑料袋，白色污染仍是严重问题。

paragraphs.text: First, local authorities should strengthen supervision and punish businesses that ignore the rules.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 首先，地方政府应加强监管并处罚无视规定的商家。

paragraphs.text: Second, supermarkets should charge a reasonable fee for every plastic bag and offer reusable bags at low prices.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 其次，超市应对每个塑料袋收取合理费用，并低价提供可重复使用的袋子。

paragraphs.text: In addition, public campaigns should be organized to help residents understand the environmental harm caused by plastic waste.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 此外，应组织宣传活动，帮助居民了解塑料废物造成的环境危害。

paragraphs.text: I hope the newspaper will draw more attention to this issue and encourage effective action.
paragraphs.chinesePrompt: 我希望报纸更多关注这一问题并推动有效行动。

wholeImitationTasks.title: 给准备来中国留学的朋友提建议
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照求职建议信，给准备来中国留学的朋友提供建议。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear David,。
units.reference: Dear David,

units.prompt: 听说你计划来中国留学，我很高兴。
units.reference: I am glad to hear that you plan to study in China.

units.prompt: 我写信是想给你一些建议。
units.reference: I am writing to offer you some suggestions.

units.prompt: 首先，提前了解学校课程和住宿条件。
units.reference: First, learn about the university courses and accommodation in advance.

units.prompt: 其次，学习一些日常汉语，以便更容易适应生活。
units.reference: Second, learn some everyday Chinese so that you can adapt to daily life more easily.

units.prompt: 此外，可以参加迎新活动并加入学生社团。
units.reference: In addition, you may attend orientation activities and join student clubs.

units.prompt: 希望这些建议对你有用。
units.reference: I hope these suggestions will be useful.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名分别写Yours sincerely,和Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 邀请教授组织国际辩论赛团队
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照创新竞赛邀请信，邀请一位教授组织国际辩论赛团队。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Professor Brown,。
units.reference: Dear Professor Brown,

units.prompt: 我写信邀请您为下个月举行的国际辩论赛组织一支团队。
units.reference: I am writing to invite you to organize a team for the International Debate Contest to be held next month.

units.prompt: 比赛旨在提高学生的批判性思维和跨文化交流能力。
units.reference: The contest aims to improve students’ critical thinking and cross-cultural communication skills.

units.prompt: 由于您在英语教学和辩论方面经验丰富，您的指导将十分宝贵。
units.reference: Because of your rich experience in English teaching and debate, your guidance would be extremely valuable.

units.prompt: 每支队伍可由四名学生组成。
units.reference: Each team may consist of four students.

units.prompt: 学校将提供训练教室和必要资料。
units.reference: The university will provide training rooms and necessary materials.

units.prompt: 我们真诚希望您能接受邀请，并期待您的回复。
units.reference: We sincerely hope that you will accept our invitation, and I look forward to your reply.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours sincerely,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 招聘校园阅读调查项目助理
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照研究项目助理招聘通知，招聘一名校园阅读调查项目助理。

units.prompt: 标题写NOTICE。
units.reference: NOTICE

units.prompt: 李教授的校园阅读习惯研究项目需要一名学生助理。
units.reference: A student assistant is needed for Professor Li’s research project on campus reading habits.

units.prompt: 项目将于下个月开始，持续六周。
units.reference: The project will begin next month and last for six weeks.

units.prompt: 主要职责包括设计问卷、采访学生和整理数据。
units.reference: The main duties include designing questionnaires, interviewing students and organizing data.

units.prompt: 申请者应有责任心、耐心，并具有良好的沟通能力。
units.reference: Applicants should be responsible, patient and equipped with good communication skills.

units.prompt: 有调查经验的学生将被优先考虑。
units.reference: Students who have experience in surveys will be preferred.

units.prompt: 有兴趣的人应在周五前发送简短自我介绍。
units.reference: Anyone interested should send a brief self-introduction before Friday.

units.prompt: 署名写Li Ming。
units.reference: Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 回复如何准备中国传统节日口头报告
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照科学家口头报告回复信，给朋友提供准备传统节日报告的建议。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Paul,。
units.reference: Dear Paul,

units.prompt: 我很高兴就准备中国传统节日口头报告给你建议。
units.reference: I am glad to offer you some advice on preparing your oral report about a traditional Chinese festival.

units.prompt: 首先，选择一个意义重要且容易介绍的节日。
units.reference: First, choose a festival whose meaning is important and easy to explain.

units.prompt: 然后收集关于起源、习俗和文化意义的可靠信息。
units.reference: Then collect reliable information about its origin, customs and cultural meaning.

units.prompt: 最好把报告分成简要介绍、主要习俗和个人评论三部分。
units.reference: It is better to organize your report into three parts: a brief introduction, the main customs and your personal comments.

units.prompt: 最后，多练习几次并控制发言时间。
units.reference: Finally, practise several times and control your speaking time.

units.prompt: 希望这些建议能帮助你完成精彩的报告。
units.reference: I hope these suggestions will help you complete an impressive report.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 回复校园音乐节志愿帮助
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照手工艺展示回复信，回复朋友关于校园音乐节及志愿工作的询问。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Paul,。
units.reference: Dear Paul,

units.prompt: 感谢你对校园音乐节感兴趣。
units.reference: Thank you for your interest in the campus music festival.

units.prompt: 活动将于本周日下午在大学体育馆举行。
units.reference: The event will be held in the university gym this Sunday afternoon.

units.prompt: 学生乐队将表演中英文歌曲。
units.reference: Several student bands will perform Chinese and English songs.

units.prompt: 你可以协助接待表演者、引导观众并拍照。
units.reference: You can assist us in welcoming the performers, guiding the audience and taking photos.

units.prompt: 如果你能为国际学生准备英文指示牌，也会很有帮助。
units.reference: It would also be helpful if you could prepare several English signs for international students.

units.prompt: 请于周日下午1点到达体育馆，期待在那里见到你。
units.reference: Please arrive at the gym at 1:00 p.m. on Sunday, and I look forward to seeing you there.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 回复有关中国家庭老照片的问题
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照手写信件回复信，介绍一组中国家庭老照片及其展览信息。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Paul,。
units.reference: Dear Paul,

units.prompt: 你对我发布的中国家庭老照片感兴趣，我很高兴。
units.reference: I am pleased that you are interested in the old photographs of Chinese families that I posted.

units.prompt: 这些照片拍摄于20世纪70年代和80年代。
units.reference: They were taken during the 1970s and 1980s.

units.prompt: 它们记录了家庭生活、城市变化和人们的日常活动。
units.reference: The photographs record family life, urban changes and people’s daily activities.

units.prompt: 虽然照片颜色已经褪去，但其中的生活场景真实而感人。
units.reference: Although the colors have faded, the scenes of life in them are real and moving.

units.prompt: 部分原照片正在城市历史博物馆展出，大学生免费入场。
units.reference: Some of the original photographs are on display in the City History Museum, and admission is free for university students.

units.prompt: 我很乐意本周末和你一起去，请告诉我你什么时候有空。
units.reference: I would be happy to go there with you this weekend. Please let me know when you are available.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 就食物浪费问题给编辑写信
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照白色污染问题建议信，就餐厅食物浪费问题给报社编辑写信。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Editor,。
units.reference: Dear Editor,

units.prompt: 我写信是为了表达对本市餐厅食物浪费问题的担忧。
units.reference: I am writing to express my concern about food waste in restaurants in our city.

units.prompt: 尽管已经开展宣传，许多顾客仍点过多食物。
units.reference: Although public campaigns have been introduced, many customers still order more food than they need.

units.prompt: 应当采取若干措施。
units.reference: Several measures should be taken.

units.prompt: 首先，餐厅应提供小份菜并提醒顾客理性点餐。
units.reference: First, restaurants should offer smaller portions and remind customers to order food rationally.

units.prompt: 其次，应鼓励顾客打包剩余食物。
units.reference: Second, customers should be encouraged to take unfinished food home.

units.prompt: 希望报纸更多关注这一问题并推动有效行动。
units.reference: I hope the newspaper will draw more attention to this issue and encourage effective action.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours sincerely,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 向朋友推荐电影《阿甘正传》
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照电影推荐信，向朋友推荐电影Forrest Gump。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Jack,。
units.reference: Dear Jack,

units.prompt: 我写信推荐我最喜欢的电影之一《阿甘正传》。
units.reference: I am writing to recommend one of my favorite movies, Forrest Gump.

units.prompt: 影片讲述了一位善良而坚定的人面对生活挑战的故事。
units.reference: The film tells the story of a kind and determined man who faces many challenges in life.

units.prompt: 我推荐它主要有两个原因。
units.reference: I recommend it for two main reasons.

units.prompt: 首先，故事感人，展现了诚实、勇气和坚持的重要性。
units.reference: First, the story is touching and shows the importance of honesty, courage and perseverance.

units.prompt: 其次，表演自然，许多情节令人印象深刻。
units.reference: Second, the acting is natural, and many scenes are especially impressive.

units.prompt: 相信你会喜欢这部电影并从中获得启发。
units.reference: I believe you will enjoy the film and gain inspiration from it.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours sincerely,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 欢迎暑期交流项目国际学生
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照国际学生欢迎信，欢迎参加暑期交流项目的国际学生。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Exchange Students,。
units.reference: Dear Exchange Students,

units.prompt: 我谨代表学生会向你们表示最热烈的欢迎。
units.reference: On behalf of the Students’ Union, I would like to extend our warmest welcome to all of you.

units.prompt: 希望你们享受暑期项目和校园生活。
units.reference: We hope you will enjoy the summer program and campus life.

units.prompt: 为了更容易适应，建议参加迎新活动并了解课程安排。
units.reference: To adapt more easily, you are advised to attend the orientation activities and learn about the course schedule.

units.prompt: 你们还可以参加文化参观和学生社团活动。
units.reference: You may also take part in cultural visits and student club activities.

units.prompt: 遇到困难时，请随时联系国际学生办公室。
units.reference: Whenever you face difficulties, feel free to contact the International Students’ Office.

units.prompt: 祝你们度过充实而难忘的暑期时光。
units.reference: We wish you a rewarding and unforgettable summer at our university.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours sincerely,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

wholeImitationTasks.title: 向读书俱乐部推荐《小王子》
wholeImitationTasks.prompt: 仿照图书推荐信，向读书俱乐部推荐The Little Prince。

units.prompt: 称呼写Dear Club Members,。
units.reference: Dear Club Members,

units.prompt: 下一次读书活动，我想推荐圣埃克苏佩里的《小王子》。
units.reference: For our next reading session, I would like to recommend The Little Prince by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.

units.prompt: 这本书讲述了一位小王子在不同星球旅行的故事。
units.reference: The book tells the story of a little prince who travels to different planets.

units.prompt: 我推荐它，因为故事简单却充满意义。
units.reference: I recommend it because the story is simple but meaningful.

units.prompt: 它帮助我们思考友谊、责任和真正重要的事物。
units.reference: It helps us think about friendship, responsibility and what is truly important.

units.prompt: 此外，这本书不长，每位成员都能在活动前读完。
units.reference: In addition, the book is not very long, so every member can finish it before the session.

units.prompt: 希望你们喜欢阅读并在活动中分享想法。
units.reference: I hope you will enjoy reading it and share your ideas at the session.

units.prompt: 结束语和署名写Yours sincerely,与Li Ming。
units.reference:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复如何准备中国古代科学家口头报告 · 收集资料
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 然后收集关于起源、习俗和文化意义的可靠信息。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Then collect reliable information about its origin, customs and cultural meaning.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复如何准备中国古代科学家口头报告 · 组织结构
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 最好把报告分成简要介绍、主要习俗和个人评论三部分。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: It is better to organize your report into three parts: a brief introduction, the main customs and your personal comments.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复传统手工艺展示活动 · 感谢与回应
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 感谢你对校园音乐节感兴趣。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Thank you for your interest in the campus music festival.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复传统手工艺展示活动 · 时间与地点
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 活动将于本周日下午在大学体育馆举行。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The event will be held in the university gym this Sunday afternoon.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复传统手工艺展示活动 · 活动内容
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 学生乐队将表演中英文歌曲。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Several student bands will perform Chinese and English songs.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复传统手工艺展示活动 · 志愿任务
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 你可以协助接待表演者、引导观众并拍照。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: You can assist us in welcoming the performers, guiding the audience and taking photos.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复有关中国家庭手写信件的问题 · 回应兴趣
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 你对我发布的中国家庭老照片感兴趣，我很高兴。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: I am pleased that you are interested in the old photographs of Chinese families that I posted.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复有关中国家庭手写信件的问题 · 时间介绍
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 这些照片拍摄于20世纪70年代和80年代。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: They were taken during the 1970s and 1980s.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复有关中国家庭手写信件的问题 · 内容介绍
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 它们记录了家庭生活、城市变化和人们的日常活动。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The photographs record family life, urban changes and people’s daily activities.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 回复有关中国家庭手写信件的问题 · 价值评价
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 虽然照片颜色已经褪去，但其中的生活场景真实而感人。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Although the colors have faded, the scenes of life in them are real and moving.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 就塑料袋和白色污染问题给报社编辑写信 · 写信目的
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 我写信是为了表达对本市餐厅食物浪费问题的担忧。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: I am writing to express my concern about food waste in restaurants in our city.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 就塑料袋和白色污染问题给报社编辑写信 · 问题现状
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 尽管已经开展宣传，许多顾客仍点过多食物。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Although public campaigns have been introduced, many customers still order more food than they need.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 就塑料袋和白色污染问题给报社编辑写信 · 措施总起
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 应当采取若干措施。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Several measures should be taken.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 就塑料袋和白色污染问题给报社编辑写信 · 第一条措施
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 首先，餐厅应提供小份菜并提醒顾客理性点餐。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: First, restaurants should offer smaller portions and remind customers to order food rationally.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向朋友推荐一部喜欢的电影 · 推荐目的
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 我写信推荐我最喜欢的电影之一《阿甘正传》。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: I am writing to recommend one of my favorite movies, Forrest Gump.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向朋友推荐一部喜欢的电影 · 内容介绍
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 影片讲述了一位善良而坚定的人面对生活挑战的故事。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The film tells the story of a kind and determined man who faces many challenges in life.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向朋友推荐一部喜欢的电影 · 理由总起
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 我推荐它主要有两个原因。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: I recommend it for two main reasons.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向朋友推荐一部喜欢的电影 · 第一条理由
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 首先，故事感人，展现了诚实、勇气和坚持的重要性。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: First, the story is touching and shows the importance of honesty, courage and perseverance.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 欢迎国际学生并提供校园生活建议 · 欢迎表达
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 我谨代表学生会向你们表示最热烈的欢迎。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: On behalf of the Students’ Union, I would like to extend our warmest welcome to all of you.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 欢迎国际学生并提供校园生活建议 · 表达希望
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 希望你们享受暑期项目和校园生活。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: We hope you will enjoy the summer program and campus life.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 欢迎国际学生并提供校园生活建议 · 第一条建议
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 为了更容易适应，建议参加迎新活动并了解课程安排。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: To adapt more easily, you are advised to attend the orientation activities and learn about the course schedule.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 欢迎国际学生并提供校园生活建议 · 补充建议
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 你们还可以参加文化参观和学生社团活动。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: You may also take part in cultural visits and student club activities.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向读书俱乐部成员推荐一本书 · 推荐目的
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 下一次读书活动，我想推荐圣埃克苏佩里的《小王子》。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: For our next reading session, I would like to recommend The Little Prince by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向读书俱乐部成员推荐一本书 · 内容介绍
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 这本书讲述了一位小王子在不同星球旅行的故事。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The book tells the story of a little prince who travels to different planets.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向读书俱乐部成员推荐一本书 · 理由总起
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 我推荐它，因为故事简单却充满意义。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: I recommend it because the story is simple but meaningful.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 向读书俱乐部成员推荐一本书 · 主题意义
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 它帮助我们思考友谊、责任和真正重要的事物。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: It helps us think about friendship, responsibility and what is truly important.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 给新入学国际学生的图书馆通知 · 欢迎语
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 欢迎来到大学体育中心。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Welcome to the university sports center.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 给新入学国际学生的图书馆通知 · 通知目的
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 为了帮助新入学国际学生使用设施，现提供以下信息。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: To help newly enrolled international students use the facilities, the following information is provided.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 给新入学国际学生的图书馆通知 · 开放时间
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 体育中心工作日开放时间为上午7点至晚上9点。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The sports center is open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on weekdays.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 给新入学国际学生的图书馆通知 · 服务设施
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 学生凭学生卡可以使用健身房、篮球场和游泳池。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Students may use the gym, basketball courts and swimming pool with their student cards.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园读书节会议纪要 · 会议重点
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 会议重点讨论了志愿服务周的安排。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The meeting focused on the arrangements for Volunteer Service Week.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园读书节会议纪要 · 会议决定
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 会议决定活动将于11月20日开始。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: It was decided that the event would begin on November 20.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园读书节会议纪要 · 主要活动
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 主要活动包括社区服务、环保宣传和老年人帮助。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The main activities will include community service, environmental campaigns and assistance for elderly people.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园读书节会议纪要 · 任务分工
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 宣传组负责制作海报，后勤组准备物资。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The publicity group will design posters, and the logistics group will prepare the necessary materials.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园清洁日公告 · 活动目的
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 为了提高学生的阅读兴趣，我校将于本周日组织校园阅读日。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: To improve students’ interest in reading, our university will organize a Campus Reading Day this Sunday.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园清洁日公告 · 时间与地点
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 活动将于上午9点在图书馆广场开始，持续约三小时。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: The activity will begin at 9:00 a.m. in the library square and last for about three hours.
sentenceImitationTasks.frame: The activity will begin at...and last for...

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园清洁日公告 · 活动内容
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 参与者可以交换图书、参加朗读比赛并听作家讲座。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: Participants may exchange books, take part in a reading competition and attend a lecture by a writer.

sentenceImitationTasks.title: 校园清洁日公告 · 参加对象
sentenceImitationTasks.prompt: 欢迎所有学生参加。
sentenceImitationTasks.reference: All students are welcome to participate.

formatGuides.title: 通知 Notice
order: 第一段：说明活动或通知目的
第二段：时间、地点、内容、职责或要求
第三段：报名方式、截止时间或注意事项
formatGuides.example: NOTICE → 三段正文 → Students’ Union / Li Ming

formatGuides.title: 普通邮件或书信
order: 第一段：问候并说明写信目的
第三段：表达希望、感谢或期待回复
formatGuides.example: Dear John, → 三段正文 → Yours sincerely, → Li Ming

formatGuides.title: 回复邮件
order: 第一段：回应问题或表示感谢
第三段：表达帮助意愿或期待见面
formatGuides.example: Dear Paul, → 回应与回答 → Yours, → Li Ming

formatGuides.title: 会议纪要
formatGuides.example: MEETING MINUTES → 基本信息 → 正文 → Recorded by Li Ming

formatGuides.title: 公告 Announcement
order: 第二段：时间、地点和内容
第三段：参加方式和注意事项
